verdict.rationale: Open WebUI is self-hosted and built to run entirely offline, so user data stays on the user's own infrastructure. API keys let external code call the same endpoints the web UI uses, which offers an indirect, do-it-yourself way to pull data out. However, the pack documents no explicit export feature or open export format. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of chats, memories, files and settings; named open export formats (e.g. JSON or Markdown); a documented migration or offboarding path; independent corroboration of data portability.
